title: Storm Spirit Awakening
description: A spectral female spirit with flowing white hair and a glowing ethereal body emerges from swirling purple storm clouds above an industrial wasteland. Below, three figures in period clothing stand on wet cobblestones holding a lantern, one shielding their face as papers and glowing particles swirl violently around them in the rain.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a glowing ethereal female spirit with long flowing white hair materializing from a massive swirling purple and teal vortex of storm clouds in a dark rainy sky, the spirit reaching down toward three awestruck people in 19th century clothing standing on wet cobblestones of an abandoned industrial area with pipes and machinery, one man holding a lantern, papers and glowing green particles flying through the heavy rain and wind, cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere
